target.title: Gary Habermas - Chapter 003 - Remarkably Early Historical Information for the Resurrection of Jesus - Gary Habermas
target.domain: Christian apologetics / historical argument for the resurrection (spoken lecture transcript)
target.comparison_class: paper of similar purpose and evidence burden
target.population_boundary: Speaker (Gary Habermas) and named scholars/critics he cites; audience addressed but not individually represented; no outsider or harmed-party testimony included
target.time_window: lecture delivered ~2020s; historical claims span 30-95 AD and modern scholarship

gate_results.rationale: Claims are tied to named scholars and texts (Lüdemann, Ehrman, Galatians 1-2, 1 Cor 15) and dates are explicitly flagged as critical/consensus dates, but quotations are paraphrased from memory, no citations given, and several datings are asserted without sourcing.
gate_results.resolution: Traceable in outline; would need page-level citation to pass.

gate_results.rationale: Speaker acknowledges disputes (Galatians dating, Peter-behind-Mark majority 'barely', 30 vs 33 AD) and treats them as bounded, not load-bearing.
Historical-evidence argument is kept within its method, but the leap from 'critics grant the data' to 'Christianity is true' (S006, S012) exceeds what historical method alone yields.
Speaker names what would count against him (myth, telephone-tag, misconstrued data) and engages the objection, but does not state what evidence would overturn his own conclusion.
Cross-domain moves (psychology of doubt, genre theory of Greco-Roman bios) are invoked without explicit bridge conditions or kill criteria.
Named sources and scripture refs are given, but no bibliographic citations; transcript is auto-captioned with acknowledged caption noise and no speaker labels.
Persuasion by argument in a voluntary lecture setting; no coercion, threat, or concealed compulsion; audience free to reject (S547, S548).

fruit_profile.mechanism: truth-aligned relational cohesion seeking the good of the whole and each member while bearing cost and preserving agency

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: I hope it's going to help all of you in your walk with the Lord.

counterevidence.link_reason: Mocking dismissal of an interlocutor's position

fruit_profile.rationale: Warm pastoral intent toward in-group; no evidence of costly love toward outsiders or critics.

fruit_profile.mechanism: durable participation in real good not dependent on denial, spectacle, status, or constant stimulation

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: The resurrection of Jesus is the most exciting, I think, subject in scripture.
Christ gives us the abundant life now and eternity.
positive_evidence.link_reason: Joy grounded in claimed good, not spectacle

fruit_profile.rationale: Genuine enthusiasm expressed; no evidence of joy persisting under cost or across contexts.

fruit_profile.mechanism: reintegrated order in which relevant tensions are truthfully addressed without suppression

counterevidence.quote_or_event: You have to tell your emotions where to get off.
counterevidence.link_reason: Frames emotional tension as to be suppressed rather than addressed

fruit_profile.rationale: Peace framed as resolve; emotional doubt handled by dismissal of feeling, a possible suppression pattern.

fruit_profile.mechanism: preservation of persons and processes across the time required for truth, growth, correction, or convergence while acting when action is due
fruit_profile.rationale: Long research program cited; little evidence of patience toward opposing views.

fruit_profile.mechanism: low-friction repair and assistance that reduces needless barriers without erasing truth or responsibility

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: two of them are on my website, garyhabermas.com. They're free.
I don't sell anything on my website.

counterevidence.link_reason: Blunt dismissal of a common apologetic

fruit_profile.rationale: Real low-cost assistance (free books) alongside dismissive rhetoric toward critics.

fruit_profile.mechanism: truth-aligned action producing real non-malign benefit after costs and externalities are counted

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: He takes up an offering, probably the third one that day, for for Some of you know what I mean.
positive_evidence.link_reason: Cited charitable collection for the poor

fruit_profile.rationale: Benefit is mostly intellectual/pastoral; no evidence of exported harm, but also little verified downstream benefit.

fruit_profile.mechanism: invariant fidelity across time, audiences, incentives, and pressure, joined to correction when the object of loyalty is false

positive_evidence.link_reason: Commits to opponent-admitted data rather than favorable sources

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: I'm not saying that that that word has to mean history in that context
positive_evidence.link_reason: Declines to overclaim on a lexical point

counterevidence.link_reason: Admits gap in his own argument

fruit_profile.rationale: Consistent method across the lecture, self-limits on contested points; correction of his own claims is present but narrow.

fruit_profile.mechanism: power precisely restrained to the minimum force sufficient for the good while protecting the vulnerable

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: I wouldn't want to call all of them liars
I was going to make a little joke, but I won't do that.

fruit_profile.rationale: Some deliberate restraint; occasional ridicule of critics shows force not fully minimized.

fruit_profile.mechanism: boundary integrity and governance of appetite, impulse, scope, and optimization under the true good

positive_evidence.quote_or_event: I'm not going to be able to do all eight, but I'm going to do the most four most important ones for you tonight.
positive_evidence.link_reason: Scopes claims to what time allows

counterevidence.quote_or_event: I'm going to do this part real fast.

fruit_profile.rationale: Explicit scoping and self-limitation; some rushed, over-broad framing ('Christianity is true').

contradictions.consequence: Dating and source disputes flagged as disputed rather than hidden.
Historical-evidence method and metaphysical conclusion sit at different confidence levels; not reconciled in text.

stakeholder_divergence.observation: Cited as authorities whose data is accepted, but characterized in places as motivated by worldview rather than evidence (S219-S222).
Addressed warmly; emotional doubters told their doubt is not factual (S561).

missing_evidence: No bibliographic citations for Lüdemann, Ehrman, or the University of London dissertation
No outsider or critic self-report; critics characterized only through the speaker
No evidence of downstream outcomes of the free books or the psychological study
No speaker labels in transcript; some sentences ambiguous between speakers
repair_path: Add page-level citations for every scholar quoted
State explicitly what evidence would falsify the resurrection conclusion
Separate historical-method conclusion from the metaphysical claim 'Christianity is true'
Include critic self-representation rather than paraphrase
parsed.falsifier: A documented case where the speaker's cited critical datings or quotations are materially misrepresented, or where he refuses correction of a load-bearing claim when shown wrong.
limitations: Auto-captioned transcript; caption errors and missing speaker labels are not the speaker's fault
Single lecture; no longitudinal or cross-context behavioral evidence
Fruit scores rest on spoken intent and process, not verified outcomes

Per-sentence summary shows near-zero fruit signal; I treat its 'top_away' items (S006, S012, S143) as weak signals only, and disagree that S006/S012 are anti-fruit — they are scope issues, not character evidence
